local createFCOISDynamicMarkersMenu = function ( item, fcoisItemId ) local submenu = { } local name for i = FCOIS_CON_ICON_DYNAMIC_1, FCOIS_CON_ICON_DYNAMIC_30 do name = FCOIS.settingsVars.settings.icon [ i ].name or "" table.insert ( submenu, createFCOISSubMenuItem ( item, fcoisItemId, i, "Mark as " .. name, "Unmark as " .. name, "marked as " .. name, "unmarked as " .. name ) ) end return submenu end
